method: Read-only review of production implementation, test assertions and retained execution evidence. No additional product mutations, no new test executions, and no goal status changes in this audit.

status_definitions.proven: Implementation and relevant observed behavior support the capability, within the explicitly named execution layer and environment.
status_definitions.pending: Implementation may exist, but a required final verification or deliverable is still outstanding. This does not assert a product defect.
status_definitions.contradicted: Current implementation or actual execution contradicts the requirement. Historical fixed failures are listed separately and do not count as current failures.

release_boundary.note: Earlier installed success proves that candidate's behavior. It does not prove that the subsequent PdfViewer/useReadingState performance changes are embedded in or accepted through the final installer.

items.name: 可追溯笔记

capabilities.name: Page bookmark, text highlight, region note and paper-level note
capabilities.evidence: Real browser/API creates cross-page highlight and region note; installed UI creates bookmark and paper note; frozen API creates all kinds.

capabilities.name: Quote, page, raw PDF coordinates, multiple rectangles and colors/tags remain editable
capabilities.evidence: Actual PDF text layer selections at DPR 1/2, native rotation/CropBox/UserUnit and real note save/reload assertions; notebook color/tag/body editing and CAS conflict flow.

capabilities.name: Delete/undo preserves saved user edits
capabilities.evidence: Notebook delete/recovery and edited-bookmark guard before removal followed by undo.

capabilities.name: Real Docling reparse leaves annotation data unchanged
capabilities.evidence: Frozen 0.2.0 worker completed a new revision after 5 manually edited version-2 annotations; every returned field, location, version and timestamp remained equal.

items.qualification: The 81-page component stress test preserves an eight-page selection with 80 locations; it is a generated PDF interaction test, not Docling accuracy evidence.

capabilities.name: Paper note panel, global note list, search, source/type/tag filters and pagination
capabilities.evidence: UI wiring reviewed; real API filter/pagination tests and real notebook create/search flow. Production-bundle synthetic 1000-note browser workload exercises list paging and unique/cohort queries. Not every filter combination has a separate native UI test.

capabilities.name: Search result and original-source navigation
capabilities.evidence: Notebook global Ctrl+K search opens the selected note's reader; installed source navigation and repeated outline jumps are exercised.

capabilities.name: JSON/Markdown contain provenance, locations and user content
capabilities.evidence: Real browser JSON download plus frozen/installed API JSON and Markdown exports; reparse/restore exports preserve all 5 records and identical Markdown hashes.

capabilities.name: Cancel the native Save dialog without a false success message or output file
capabilities.evidence: saveBlob returns false on an empty dialog result and App.run suppresses success toast. Existing export-guards tests cancel an edit decision, and installed notes export calls the real API directly; neither observes native Save cancellation.
capabilities.next: Desktop agent is assigned a real native Save-dialog cancellation check on the rebuilt installer.

capabilities.name: Deduplicated paper tabs, history, session and collection state restoration
capabilities.evidence: Five real API/UI workspace cases exercise tabs, Ctrl+Tab/Alt history, cached filters, gallery page two, scroll and focus restoration; native restart covers saved workspace.

capabilities.name: Resizable/collapsible reader panel, fit-width/fit-page and PDF find
capabilities.evidence: Actual PDF.js component browser assertions and real API visual snapshots; keyboard follow-up verifies reader search and tab navigation.

capabilities.name: Search/gallery jumps and retained Ctrl+K
capabilities.evidence: Notebook global search-to-reader test plus real legacy crop/search/gallery workflow and DPR2 geometry regression.

items.name: 修改保护

capabilities.name: Paper metadata, outline, resource/table and annotation cancel/discard/save guards
capabilities.evidence: Real API/UI workspace and notebook tests; deliberately injected 503 failures retain drafts and block navigation; prefilled region selection also requires a decision.

capabilities.name: Concurrent edits and reading conflicts never silently overwrite
capabilities.evidence: Real API CAS tests and real browser conflict choices; local full view is retried, and adopting saved state actually moves the viewer.

capabilities.name: Library switch and native window close await or preserve drafts
capabilities.evidence: Actual Tauri WM_CLOSE cancel/save/restart/discard with port shutdown; installed same-id clone switch clears stale UI operations and rejects old-scope requests.

items.qualification: Fault injection is explicit and does not fabricate successful saves. The dedicated WM_CLOSE draft test uses a debug Tauri executable; final installed clean close and migration are separate evidence. Forced termination/power loss may lose unsent drafts and is documented.

capabilities.name: 0001 migration has a pre-upgrade backup and transactional failure recovery
capabilities.evidence: Real SQLite migration/failure injection tests plus actual installed 0.2 app migration of a library made by the old frozen backend; source PDF and metadata hashes retained.

capabilities.name: Validation, optimistic transactions, removed-paper isolation and restart
capabilities.evidence: 117-test complete backend run includes finite/page/CropBox/length limits, simultaneous-version writers, rollback after index failure, removed-paper search exclusion and state restart.

capabilities.name: Backup, real worker reparse and restore retain user data and original PDFs
capabilities.evidence: Independent frozen backend acceptance compares complete 5-annotation and reading-state snapshots before/after actual Docling reparse and after real ZIP backup restoration, with FTS 5/5 and source SHA unchanged.

items.name: UI

capabilities.name: Neutral light/dark desktop layout without slogans or decorative summary cards
capabilities.evidence: 44 real-data screenshots across 1440x1000 and 1280x800; this auditor additionally inspected the compact dark reader and light notebook images.

capabilities.name: Visible status, empty/error/retry states, safe text preview and keyboard focus
capabilities.evidence: Failure-preservation UI flows, actual reading conflict toolbar, literal script-like note text, and two-screenshot keyboard follow-up with arrow/Home/End/manual tab activation.

capabilities.name: High-DPI PDF geometry
capabilities.evidence: Browser DPR1/DPR2 glyph checks and real DPR2 geometry regression covering rotation/CropBox/UserUnit; this proves browser deviceScaleFactor behavior, not changed Windows system DPI.

capabilities.name: 1000-annotation rendering after optimization
capabilities.evidence: Real production dist and separate API with explicitly synthetic 1000-record/3000-rectangle workload: scroll frame p95 16.8ms, main-thread duty fraction 0.1342 versus archived 0.7084. Final installer embedding is still pending item 8.

items.qualification: The main-thread fraction is CDP TaskDuration divided by the measured phase duration, not total machine CPU percentage. It is not a low-end hardware guarantee.

items.name: 时长

measurement.observer: root agent get_goal and clock tools

items.evidence: Root supplied the exact goal snapshot to this audit. The subagent's own get_goal returns null, so no independent subagent timer is invented.
items.qualification: Threshold passage does not complete the goal while delivery gates remain pending. Development, real regression, packaging, visual checks, conflict repairs and rendering performance measurement are substantive recorded work; no repeated idle wait is counted as a feature result.

Build and accept the exact final installer containing the tested rendering performance changes; archive candidate/final hashes separately.

retained_boundaries: The generated fixture PDF/component browser tests are distinguished from real API workflows and installed app workflows.
The 1000-annotation and gallery loads contain synthetic metadata and do not prove parsing accuracy.
Browser DPR2 is not an actual Windows system display-scaling change.
This host contains development tools; clean VM and hosted CI remain unverified.
The prior native access violation diagnostic was not reproduced and is not declared harmless or solved.
The 81-page extreme test measured browser process-tree RSS; the 16M-pixel canvas cap is not a process memory cap.
